title: Weather in MallWorld
content: I just have a quick question for everyone. What type of weather often occurs in your MallWorld? For me, I think the most favorable version that I have is of being in a mall food court that is not so brightly lit (think of semi-bright incandescent lights higher up as the ceiling is about three or four stories up) contrasting with ceiling skylights that are overhead and you can see that the sky is dark from being overcast but not night. There is the murmur of conversation, and you can occasionally hear thunder from the outside and a steady rain hitting the skylights. In another one, I found myself on a college campus and am in a student center or cafeteria and it is snowing outside. The excitement in this dream is off the charts as I feel as though I am in my teens or early 20s again. I'm usually walking around or looking out of the windows with friends and marveling at the wintery weather. Anyone else experience this?
